title: Anytime Pretraining: Horizon-Free Learning-Rate Schedules with Weight Averaging
abstract: arXiv:2602.03702v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained in continual or open-ended settings, where the total training horizon is not known in advance. Despite this, most existing pretraining recipes are not anytime: they rely on horizon-dependent learning rate schedules and extensive tuning under a fixed compute budget. In this work, we provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating the existence of anytime learning schedules for overparameterized linear regression, and we highlight the central role of weight averaging - also known as model merging - in achieving the minimax convergence rates of stochastic gradient descent. We show that these anytime schedules polynomially decay with time, with the decay rate determined by the source and capacity conditions of the problem. translated_title: 随时预训练：基于权重平均的无水平学习率调度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.03702v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地在持续或开放式的环境中训练，其中总训练时长事先未知。尽管如此，大多数现有的预训练方案并非“随时”的：它们依赖于与训练水平相关的学习率调度，并在固定的计算预算下进行大量调优。在这项工作中，我们提供了理论分析，证明了过参数化线性回归中存在随时学习调度，并强调了权重平均（也称为模型合并）在实现随机梯度下降的极小极大收敛率中的核心作用。我们表明，这些随时调度随时间呈多项式衰减，衰减率由问题的源条件和容量条件决定。在实验上，我们评估了训练至32倍Chinchilla规模的1.5亿和3亿参数语言模型，比较了常数和$1/\sqrt{t}$调度与权重平均的效果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需预知训练时长的“随时”学习率调度方法，通过权重平均实现理论最优收敛，并在大规模语言模型训练中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an "anytime" learning-rate schedule that requires no prior knowledge of training horizon, achieving minimax convergence via weight averaging, validated on large-scale language models.
